text: ① 08:30 澳洲联储发布9月货币政策会议的纪要文件； ② 时间待定 清华大学经管学院顾问委员会年度会议（新增黄仁勋、苏姿丰等委员）； ③ 10:00 国际货币基金组织（IMF）公布《世界经济展望》报告； ④ 11:00 英国央行货币政策委员会（MPC）成员Greene在泰国曼谷讲话； ⑤ 14:00 德国9月CPI终值； ⑥ 时间待定 英国议会AI安全听证会（美四大实验室出席）； ⑦ 15:45 美联储理事沃勒在AI时代的彭博新经济论坛谈论经济政策； ⑧ 美股盘前 高盛、花旗集团、摩根大通、富国银行、强生、联合健康等发布业绩报告； ⑨ 时间待定 石油
text_en: ① 08:30 RBA releases the minutes of its September monetary policy meeting; ② Time TBD Tsinghua University School of Economics and Management Advisory Board annual meeting (new members include Jensen Huang, Lisa Su, and others); ③ 10:00 IMF releases the World Economic Outlook report; ④ 11:00 Bank of England Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) member Greene speaks in Bangkok, Thailand; ⑤ 14:00 Germany September CPI final reading; ⑥ Time TBD UK parliamentary AI safety hearing (the four major US labs attend); ⑦ 15:45 Fed Governor Waller discusses economic policy at the Bloomberg New Economy Forum in the AI era; ⑧ US premarket Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, JPMorgan Chase, Wells Fargo, Johnson & Johnson, UnitedHealth and others release earnings reports; ⑨ Time TBD oil
